step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram visually depicts users interacting with Amazon Connect. Amazon Connect initiates a data dip to Salesforce via a Lambda function for customer information. Separately, Amazon Connect sends call recordings to an S3 bucket for post-call processing by Transcribe and Comprehend. Concurrently, Amazon Connect emits events for reporting and analytics, which land in a separate S3 bucket and are then processed by Athena. All nodes and edges are derived directly from the visual diagram and confirmed with the transcript, ensuring adherence to the 'visual-first' and 'strictly parsimonious' rules. Services like Lex, Kinesis, and Kinesis Firehose, though mentioned in the transcript, are omitted as they are not explicitly drawn as distinct visual components on the whiteboard. The unconnected Lambda icon at the bottom of the diagram is also omitted as it lacks explicit visual connections.

graph.name: Intuit Global Contact Center
graph.notes: Intuit's architecture for a global contact center, leveraging Amazon Connect for customer interactions, Lambda for CRM data dips, S3 for call recordings and analytics events, and AI/ML services (Transcribe, Comprehend) for post-call analysis, alongside Athena for reporting.

nodes.name: Users
nodes.notes: Customers calling into the contact center.

nodes.name: Connect
nodes.notes: Handles incoming calls and routes interactions.

nodes.name: Analytics S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores event data from Amazon Connect for reporting and analytics.

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Queries the analytics data stored in S3.

nodes.name: CRM Data Dip Lambda
nodes.notes: Executes a data dip to the CRM system to retrieve customer information.

nodes.name: Salesforce CRM
nodes.notes: External CRM system for customer data. Represented as Salesforce.

nodes.name: Call Recordings S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores call recordings from Amazon Connect.

nodes.name: Transcribe
nodes.notes: Processes call recordings from S3 for transcription.

nodes.name: Comprehend
nodes.notes: Performs sentiment analysis on call recordings from S3.

edges.notes: Users initiate calls to Amazon Connect.
Amazon Connect triggers Lambda for a data dip.
Lambda queries Salesforce CRM for customer data.
Salesforce CRM returns customer data to Lambda.
Amazon Connect stores call recordings in S3.
S3 triggers Transcribe for call transcription.
S3 triggers Comprehend for sentiment analysis of call recordings.
Amazon Connect emits events for reporting to S3.
Athena queries event data stored in S3 for analytics.
